subject.title: [security] Terminal control sequences from JUnit failures are replayed in CLI results output

question: Should Crabbox treat structured JUnit failure-message rendering as a supported local CLI security boundary and sanitize human output by default?
rationale: The report is source-reproducible and maps to SECURITY.md's command-injection language, but the repository's trusted-operator model makes final security classification and disclosure handling a maintainer policy choice.

options.title: Accept and sanitize human renderers
options.body: Treat the structured results display as a local CLI boundary and strip or neutralize terminal controls in all human TestFailure renderers while preserving machine JSON output.

options.title: Fix as hardening only
options.body: Land the same display-safety change as defense in depth without security-release or advisory handling.

options.title: Reject as expected trusted output
options.body: Document that JUnit failure text is trusted project output and close the security claim as outside Crabbox's supported boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept and sanitize human renderers
recommendation.body: Treat the structured results display as a local CLI boundary and strip or neutralize terminal controls in all human TestFailure renderers while preserving machine JSON output.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the recent JUnit-results feature history and is the clearest available route for the security-boundary decision.
